We are building KeilHQ around a simple belief:

AI should not just answer questions. It should understand how a company works and help get the work done

We are bringing together the work, decisions, processes, customers, finance and context that are scattered across different tools, so teams can spend less time searching, coordinating and managing work, and more time actually doing it

Being part of Sarvam’s Startup Program gives us the opportunity to build with some of the strongest AI infrastructure being built for India, while pushing our vision of making AI a true operational layer for companies

Grateful to the Sarvam AI team for the opportunity and for backing builders
